title: Joint parametric and non-parametric memory
input: Find the original method that combines parametric seq2seq memory with non-parametric Wikipedia memory and jointly trains the neural retriever and generator for knowledge-intensive generation. Exclude fixed-retriever readers and chunked retrieval language-model pretraining.
